info.name: Toornament Tournaments API
info.description:
The Toornament API v2 provides comprehensive esports tournament management capabilities. It includes the Organizer API for full tournament CRUD operations, the Viewer API for public read-only tournament data access, and the Participant API for registration and check-in management. Authentication uses API key plus OAuth2 access tokens with scoped permissions.

Contact Support:
 Name: Toornament Developer
